metadata.audit_standard: Principal ML Infrastructure & Cloud FinOps Architect

gpu_compute.cluster_sizing: Auto-scaling 1 to 4 instances; average 1.5 instances active 24/7
gpu_compute.description: Primary neural 3D and SegFormer B2 inference execution

cpu_compute_api.instance_type: AWS Fargate / ECS (2 vCPU, 4GB RAM API Gateway & Orchestrator)
cpu_compute_api.description: FastAPI orchestration, HMAC authentication, request validation

storage.service: AWS S3 Standard (Tiered Lifecycle to Glacier Flexible Retrieval)
storage.description: Storage of generated binary GLB meshes, texture albedo maps, and job logs

network_egress.service: AWS CloudFront CDN + Data Transfer Out
network_egress.description: Delivery of binary GLB assets to Three.js client browsers

queue_and_state.description: Durable priority job queue, worker heartbeats, and rate limiting

observability.service: Datadog / Amazon CloudWatch (Metrics, Distributed Traces, Alarms)
observability.description: P50/P95/P99 latency tracking, GPU duty cycle, error alerting

idle_capacity_overhead.description: Minimum 1 warm standby spot instance during low-traffic nocturnal hours

failed_jobs_overhead.description: Compute consumed by malformed inputs or user cancellations

summary_cost_analysis.disclaimer: Cloud estimate based on published AWS pricing. Real cloud invoices will only be generated upon authorized production cluster provisioning.
